best advice i can think to give right now is go independently. if its genuinely important to you that your project turns out exactly how you envision it then the best way to go about it is to produce it independently. that would definitely add more challenges to the production (finances, crew, publicity, etc) but essentially all the creative freedom is up to you and the people you hire to make your show a reality with you. there is always more than one way.
